brief_data.deck: SambaNova, the Palo Alto AI-chip maker, completed the first close of a $1B Series F at an $11B post-money valuation on 8 July 2026, led by General Atlantic, five months after a $350M Series E at a reported $2.2B. JPMorganChase was named an on-premises inference customer the same day.

risks.label: SECOND CLOSE UNCONFIRMED
risks.detail: The 8 July release called it a first close with more expected within weeks; no completion had been announced by early September.
risks.counter: Anchor on the $1B first close; ask for the final size and the IPO timetable on the call.

risks.label: GROQ GOT THERE FIRST
risks.detail: McLaren's Groq deal owns the inference-chip narrative on the grid; a second entrant risks reading as a copy.
risks.counter: Sell the on-premises deployment and the JPMorgan private-inference story: a system in the factory, not a logo.

brief_data.ticker: Private ($11B post-money; $1B Series F first close, Jul 2026)

gridfit.label: OPEN
gridfit.detail: no rival in this category lane

gridfit.label: OPEN
gridfit.detail: no rival in this category lane

extended.ask: A 25-minute call with Rodrigo Liang before the United States GP to confirm the size of the completed Series F and the listing timetable, and to size an Official AI Inference Partner entry, part-paid in systems, against Haas's 2027 roster.

value.text: An SN40L system installed at the Banbury operations base running open-weight models on the team's own data: post-session strategy analysis, telemetry anomaly detection across the car's sensor streams, engineering-document and simulation copilots for a small engineering staff. Data never leaves the building, which matters to a team whose design office sits inside Ferrari's home town.
value.label: Operational workstream (Mode A)

value.text: Systems and support can form part of the consideration, so the team gains inference capacity without cost-cap capital. The SN50, shipping from the second half of 2026, gives the partnership a hardware refresh story in each of the three years.
value.label: Cost-cap arithmetic

value.text: SambaNova's buyers are CIOs and CTOs at banks, sovereign AI programmes and neo-clouds, an audience Haas's current partners do not bring. Hospitality at Miami, Austin and Las Vegas for those accounts, and a factory reference deployment SambaNova can show every prospect.
value.label: Commercial lift for the team

value.text: Official AI Inference Partner designation, sidepod or rear-wing placement, naming of the team's inference environment, driver and engineering access for SambaNova's customer events, and engineering content from Banbury and Kannapolis on how the system is used.
value.label: What the team gives back

why_now.text: On 8 July 2026 SambaNova announced the first close of $1B in strategic financing as part of a Series F at an $11B post-money valuation, led by General Atlantic with Seligman Ventures, T. Rowe Price Associates and Capital Group, and with BlackRock, Intel Capital, the Qatar Investment Authority, Battery Ventures, Vista Equity Partners and Volantis among new and existing investors. The company said a second close was expected in the coming weeks; none had been announced by early September, so the brief anchors on the first close.
why_now.label: Trigger

why_now.text: In December 2025 Bloomberg reported Intel in advanced talks to buy SambaNova for about $1.6B including debt. The talks stalled; in February 2026 Intel instead took a stake in a $350M Series E at a reported ~$2.2B valuation and signed a multi-year partnership. Five months later the company priced at $11B. A business re-rated that fast has a story to tell to enterprise, sovereign and public-market audiences, and the money to tell it.
why_now.label: A fivefold re-rating in five months

why_now.text: The same day, JPMorganChase was named an inference-infrastructure customer, with SN40L and SN50 systems powering secure on-premises inference at the bank. The SN50 begins shipping in the second half of 2026 with SoftBank as first deployment partner in Japan; Saudi Aramco and OVHcloud are among named customers. Each shipment milestone is a moment a partnership can be timed to.
why_now.label: JPMorganChase and the SN50 ramp

why_now.text: The United States GP in October and the Las Vegas GP in November are the US rounds left in 2026, and teams close 2027 partner rosters in the fourth quarter. Rodrigo Liang has said an IPO in 2027, most likely in the US, is under consideration (reported); a deal agreed before Austin runs through the listing year.
why_now.label: Calendar and listing window

why_team.text: Haas carries Toyota Gazoo Racing as title and technical partner, Mphasis as Official Digital Partner, CommScope and Ruckus for connectivity, Orion180, Haas Automation and Haas Tooling, but no compute, AI, cloud or chip partner. Official AI Inference Partner is a clean category. Mphasis sells IT services, including AI services, so it is a channel for a deployment, not a lock on the lane.
why_team.label: The open lane

why_team.text: Haas is the grid's lean privateer, operating from Kannapolis, Banbury and a design office in Maranello with a fraction of the headcount of the works teams. Capability installed by a partner, an inference system the team could not otherwise justify inside the cost cap, is worth more to Haas than to a team with its own data-centre programme.
why_team.label: A team that needs the capability

why_team.text: SambaNova is headquartered in Palo Alto and sells to US banks, sovereign programmes and neo-clouds. Haas is the American team with three home rounds a year: Miami, Austin and Las Vegas, where the enterprise and capital-markets audience SambaNova needs for a 2027 listing already gathers.
why_team.label: American team, American buyers

why_team.text: Groq became an Official Partner of McLaren in September 2025 with its LPU chip on the car from the Singapore GP. That proved teams buy inference silicon. SambaNova's difference is the on-premises system: a deployment at Haas would be the JPMorgan story at racing speed, not a logo.
why_team.label: The precedent, and the difference

ruled_out.reason: Groq is Official Partner and the inference-chip incumbent; Google Cloud and Dell also hold cloud and hardware.
AMD, Snapdragon and Hewlett Packard Enterprise cover silicon and compute.
ARM holds the chip lane and CoreWeave the AI compute lane.
Core Scientific (data centre) and TWG AI occupy compute and AI.
Oracle is title partner and the compute incumbent.
Microsoft holds cloud and IndraMind joined in the AI lane.
HP (title) and IBM cover hardware and compute.
Claude and Airia occupy the AI lanes; VAST holds the data platform.

ruled_out.team: Audi Revolut F1 Team · Visa Cash App Racing Bulls
ruled_out.reason: Open but not chosen: Audi's roster already carries ElevenLabs in AI, and Racing Bulls lacks the US identity and home races that fit a Palo Alto company heading for a US listing.

brief_data.bottom_line: A $1B first close at $11B, a fivefold re-rating in five months, JPMorganChase on-premises and an IPO under consideration put SambaNova at peak brand-investment authority. Haas has no compute or chip partner, Groq at McLaren proved the category, and two US races remain inside the window.

brief_data.the_case_p1: General Atlantic led the $1B first close, with Seligman Ventures, T. Rowe Price Associates and Capital Group, alongside BlackRock, Intel Capital, the Qatar Investment Authority, Battery Ventures and Vista Equity Partners; a second close was expected within weeks. Five months earlier SambaNova raised a $350M Series E with Intel after Bloomberg-reported takeover talks near $1.6B stalled, so the price has risen roughly fivefold since February. Proceeds expand production of the SN40L and the SN50, shipping in the second half of 2026 with SoftBank first. Liang says a 2027 IPO is under consideration (reported).
brief_data.the_case_p2: The grid has a precedent: McLaren named Groq an Official Partner in September 2025, putting an inference chip on the car from the Singapore GP with a pitch of fast, cost-efficient intelligence for analysis and development. SambaNova is the other US inference-silicon company at scale, now with JPMorganChase running its systems on-premises. It has no seat, and it is the one with a public-market clock starting to run.

brief_data.value_content: MODE A - operational. An SN40L system at Banbury running open-weight models on the team's own data: strategy post-processing between sessions, telemetry anomaly detection, engineering-document and simulation copilots, none of it leaving the building. JPMorganChase chose SambaNova for that private, on-premises inference. The hardware can form part of the consideration for a cost-capped team; for SambaNova, a reference deployment to show every sovereign and enterprise buyer.
brief_data.why_team_para: Haas is the American team with no compute, AI or chip partner: Toyota Gazoo Racing as title and technical partner, Mphasis for digital services, CommScope and Ruckus for connectivity, no silicon. It is the lean privateer, so a partner that installs capability the team could not buy is worth more here than anywhere. Kannapolis and Banbury give SambaNova a US and a UK site; three home races put the brand in front of its buyers.
brief_data.deal_arch_para: Entry as Official AI Inference Partner. <font name='Poppins-Bold' size='9.5'>THREE YEARS</font>, 2027-2029, spanning the SN50 ramp and a possible 2027 listing. Estimated $4-7M a year, part-payable in systems and support. Scope: sidepod or rear-wing placement, naming of the team's inference environment, US-race hospitality, engineering content from Banbury.
brief_data.why_now_callout: <font name='Poppins-Bold' size='9'>WHY NOW</font>  The first close landed on 8 July with a second expected within weeks, and the SN50 ships in the second half of 2026. The United States GP in October and the Las Vegas GP in November fall inside the window, and a 2027 listing makes 2027 the brand-build year.
brief_data.decision_maker_bio: Liang co-founded SambaNova in 2017 with Stanford professors Kunle Olukotun and Christopher Ré after leading processor development at Sun Microsystems and Oracle. Path: Annie Shea Weckesser, Chief Marketing Officer; Harry Ault, Chief Revenue Officer; Matt Padfield, CFO since June 2026.
brief_data.opening_angle_quote: “Rodrigo, Groq put its chip on a McLaren the season it needed the story. You have just raised $1B at $11B with a listing in view, and the American team has no silicon partner. JPMorgan runs you on-premises; a race team could. 25 minutes before Austin?”
